title: Reported Speech 4 – Reporting verbs, Befehle & Fragen
description: say / tell, promise, admit, deny … · told him to … · asked if …

items.text: Hannah ___ that she was tired.
Hannah ___ me that she was tired.
The coach ___ the team to run faster.
Jack ___ he would be late.
My teacher ___ us a funny story.
She ___ that the shop was closed.
The pilot ___ the passengers to stay seated.
Uncle Joe ___ to me that he was moving.
items.hint: say kann mit to + Person stehen (said to me), tell braucht die Person direkt danach (told me).

items.text: Dan ___ me that he would never lie again.
The boy ___ that he had broken the window.
The waiter ___ us to take a seat.
Sue ___ that she had taken the money.
My neighbour ___ to help me with the garden.
The customer ___ that the soup was cold.
The manager ___ that the meeting would start at nine.
answers: confirmed

items.text: My brother ___ me to switch off the lights.
answers: reminded

items.text: The thief ___ that he had stolen the bike.
answers: admitted

items.text: She ___ to answer my question.
answers: refused

items.text: The guide ___ that the castle was built in 1200.
answers: explained

items.text: Lena ___ going to the beach after school.
answers: suggested

items.text: They ___ us that the train was late.
answers: informed

items.text: The boy ___ cheating and said he had played fairly.
answers: denied

items.prompt: “Close the window,” Mum said to me.
answers: Mum told me to close the window.

items.prompt: “Don’t touch the oven,” Dad said to the kids.
answers: Dad told the kids not to touch the oven.

items.prompt: “Please sit down,” the teacher said to Ben.
answers: The teacher asked Ben to sit down.

items.prompt: “Don’t be late,” Sue said to us.
answers: Sue told us not to be late.

items.prompt: “Please help me with the bags,” Gran said to Tom.
answers: Gran asked Tom to help her with the bags.

items.prompt: “Wear a helmet,” the instructor said to the children.
answers: The instructor told the children to wear a helmet.

items.prompt: “Never open this door,” the guard said to us.
answers: The guard warned us never to open that door.
The guard warned us not to open that door.

items.prompt: “Please don’t make so much noise,” Mr Evans said to the boys.
answers: Mr Evans asked the boys not to make so much noise.

items.answer: She asked where he was going.
Tom asked me if I liked pizza.
The teacher asked what time the film had started.
Lisa asked her brother whether he had seen her keys.
He asked us how long we had been waiting.
Mum asked who had eaten the last biscuit.

items.prompt: “Where do you live?” Anna asked me.
answers: Anna asked me where I lived.
Dad asked us if we were hungry.
Dad asked us whether we were hungry.

items.prompt: “What time does the bus leave?” the tourist asked.
answers: The tourist asked what time the bus left.

items.prompt: “Have you finished your homework?” Mum asked me.
answers: Mum asked me if I had finished my homework.
Mum asked me whether I had finished my homework.

items.prompt: “Can I borrow your pen?” Joe asked Kim.
answers: Joe asked Kim if he could borrow her pen.
Joe asked Kim whether he could borrow her pen.

items.prompt: “Why are you crying?” the teacher asked the boy.
answers: The teacher asked the boy why he was crying.

items.task: Gib das Gespräch in indirekter Rede wieder.
items.prompt: Alice: “Do you want something to drink?”   Phil: “I’m not thirsty.”
answers: Alice asked Phil if he wanted something to drink. Phil said (that) he was not thirsty.
Alice asked Phil whether he wanted something to drink. Phil said (that) he was not thirsty.

items.task: Gib das Gespräch in indirekter Rede wieder.
items.prompt: Kate: “Have you ever been to Paris?”   Sam: “No, I’ve never been there.”
answers: Kate asked Sam if he had ever been to Paris. Sam said (that) he had never been there.
Kate asked Sam whether he had ever been to Paris. Sam said (that) he had never been there.

items.task: Gib das Gespräch in indirekter Rede wieder.
items.prompt: Tom: “Where are you going?”   Eva: “I’m going to the library.”
answers: Tom asked Eva where she was going. Eva said (that) she was going to the library.
